server/runtime/tree.ts.name: Assignment tree helpers
server/runtime/tree.ts.description: Walks assignment lineage and applies the continuation loop guard, restart notes and terminal checks.

server/runtime/level.ts.name: Approval level cascade
server/runtime/level.ts.description: Computes a delegated turn's approval level from the requester, chief lineage and the engine's supported cap.

server/member-turn.ts.name: Member turn selection
server/member-turn.ts.description: Validates a saved model variant against engine capabilities and shapes the model selection for a room member turn.

server/main-thread.ts.name: Main thread choice
server/main-thread.ts.description: Picks a bot's main thread from its tasks, skipping routine runs and archived conversations.

server/turn-context.ts.name: Turn context builder
server/turn-context.ts.description: Chooses between resuming an engine session and replaying a transcript preamble for the next turn.

server/turn-continuation.ts.name: Step-cap handoff
server/turn-continuation.ts.description: Writes a markdown handoff file when a turn hits a step cap and detects which stops may continue.

server/turn-outcome.ts.name: Turn outcome analysis
server/turn-outcome.ts.description: Tracks why turns stopped, builds harness-observed evidence and detects outward actions that forbid a rerun.

server/turn-dispatch-guard.ts.name: Dispatch guard
server/turn-dispatch-guard.ts.description: Re-checks cancellation after sendTurn resolves and classifies admission failures that may resume when a slot frees.

server/turn-resources.ts.name: Turn resource claims
server/turn-resources.ts.description: Tracks whole-turn claims on desktops, browsers and phones so a screenshot and its click share one resource.

server/context-budget.ts.name: Compaction budget
server/context-budget.ts.description: Computes the compaction threshold from the model window and decides when measured context size demands a fold.

server/compaction-summary.ts.name: Compaction summary
server/compaction-summary.ts.description: Picks the fold point, asks a side model for a bounded summary and falls back to deterministic excerpts.

server/context-rebuild.ts.name: Context replay selection
server/context-rebuild.ts.description: Selects a bounded, byte-capped replay of history with a compaction summary and one-line tool stubs.

server/delta-context.ts.name: Delta context ledger
server/delta-context.ts.description: Tracks which messages an engine session has received and renders only the unseen ones for a resumed turn.

server/system-prompt.ts.name: System prompt builder
server/system-prompt.ts.description: Assembles ordered prompt sections and splits them into stable, volatile and roster halves for provider caching.

server/steer-queue.ts.name: Steer queue
server/steer-queue.ts.description: Persists messages sent mid-turn off the transcript, ordering and draining them as coalesced turns after the run settles.

server/channel-queue.ts.name: Channel follow-up queue
server/channel-queue.ts.description: Holds room follow-ups sent while a channel works and drains them when it settles.

server/room-queue.ts.name: Room line projection
server/room-queue.ts.description: Projects running and queued room members into per-thread queue entries for the UI.

server/room-turn-timeout.ts.name: Room turn timeout
server/room-turn-timeout.ts.description: Defines which engine events count as progress and converts configured minutes into a room turn timeout.

server/room-round-turns.ts.name: Room round limits
server/room-round-turns.ts.description: Counts each bot's turns in one room round and caps repeat answers per member.

server/room-member-lock.ts.name: Room member lock
server/room-member-lock.ts.description: Holds a bot's room turn claim across the gap before it is marked busy and notifies waiters on release.

server/quick-model-fallback.ts.name: Quick model fallback
server/quick-model-fallback.ts.description: Reruns a turn on the bot's own model under the same turn id when the quick model is refused.

server/limit-failover.ts.name: Limit failover
server/limit-failover.ts.description: Decides which backup engine may take over a usage-limited or signed-out conversation and when it returns.

server/automatic-recovery.ts.name: Startup backup choice
server/automatic-recovery.ts.description: Lists backup models for a turn that never started and refuses backups missing tools the original had.

server/repeat-detector.ts.name: Repeat call detector
server/repeat-detector.ts.description: Counts identical tool call keys per thread and reports when a repeat threshold is crossed.

server/harness/live-steps.ts.name: Live step status
server/harness/live-steps.ts.description: Turns running tool calls and their output into status-line progress frames for the chat.

server/harness/progress-gate.ts.name: Progress frame gate
server/harness/progress-gate.ts.description: Coalesces turn.progress events so the status line gets changed frames at most every 400 ms per thread.

server/harness/unasked-stop.ts.name: Unasked stop detector
server/harness/unasked-stop.ts.description: Reports an engine's unrequested abort message as a failure instead of showing it as a person's Stop.

server/harness-budget.ts.name: Harness call budgets
server/harness-budget.ts.description: Defines proxy and harness timeouts for browser, computer, data and device calls so answers outlive the callers.

server/harness-mcp-request.ts.name: Harness MCP request
server/harness-mcp-request.ts.description: Makes one MCP request to a harness tool family and words restarts or timeouts as may-have-run errors.

server/drivers/agents-mcp.ts.name: Agents MCP server
server/drivers/agents-mcp.ts.description: Answers MCP initialize, tools/list and tools/call for the agents tools, routing every call through the harness.

server/drivers/agents-proxy.ts.name: Agents stdio proxy
server/drivers/agents-proxy.ts.description: Runs the agents MCP server over stdio inside an engine process, reading JSON-RPC lines and replying.

server/drivers/agents-client.ts.name: Harness HTTP client
server/drivers/agents-client.ts.description: Calls the harness loopback internal API with the turn's capability bearer using node:http.

server/drivers/agents-check-back-tool.ts.name: Check-back tool
server/drivers/agents-check-back-tool.ts.description: Defines the check_back tool and posts its request to the harness internal check-backs route.

server/drivers/agents-wait-tools.ts.name: Wait tools
server/drivers/agents-wait-tools.ts.description: Defines wait_until, list_waits and cancel_wait and forwards them to the harness internal waits route.

server/drivers/retry.ts.name: Retry classification
server/drivers/retry.ts.description: Classifies provider errors as transient or terminal and supplies capped jittered backoff and interruptible delays.

server/drivers/prompt-split.ts.name: Prompt split helpers
server/drivers/prompt-split.ts.description: Returns the stable and volatile prompt halves and builds the context-updated note for changed volatile text.

server/agents-bridge-switch.ts.name: Tool bridge switch
server/agents-bridge-switch.ts.description: Decides per thread whether the agents tool list is bridged and rewrites bridged call titles.

server/routes/bot-messages.ts.name: Bot message routes
server/routes/bot-messages.ts.description: Handles chat sends, steers, cards and stops, deciding steer or queue through admission.

src/lib/live-events.ts.name: Live events client
src/lib/live-events.ts.description: Opens the /api/events stream with resume cursor, stale detection and retry backoff, and publishes frames.
